name: Densest Subgraph
problem_statement: Find a nonempty vertex subset maximizing total induced edge value divided by the number of selected vertices.

normalization: Reject directed input unless an explicit undirected projection is requested.
Collapse parallel edges by summing nonnegative weights; use unit weight when weight_mode=unweighted.

problem_inputs.name: weight_mode
problem_inputs.description: Use unit edge values or nonnegative input weights.

problem_inputs.name: minimum_vertices
problem_inputs.description: Minimum permitted result size; values above one define a constrained variant.

required_outputs.name: density
required_outputs.description: Total induced edge value divided by selected vertex count.

required_outputs.name: induced_edge_value
required_outputs.description: Induced edge count or weight sum.

optional_outputs.name: approximation_bound
optional_outputs.description: Certified solution-quality bound for an approximate result.

solution_semantics.objective: Maximize induced_edge_value / |S| over permitted nonempty vertex sets S.
solution_semantics.exactness: Exact mode requires optimal=true; approximate mode must disclose its bound when known.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Return one optimum unless tied solutions are explicitly added later.

validation_rules: All induced edge values are recomputed from the normalized graph.
Reported density equals induced_edge_value divided by result size.
All edge weights are nonnegative in weighted mode.
edge_cases: An edgeless nonempty graph has density zero.
Multiple distinct subsets may attain the same optimum.
An empty input graph has no feasible nonempty solution.
